# FarsiUI

> FarsiUI is a Persian-first, RTL-focused UI component library and design system. Components ship as open code you own and customize. Built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and accessible primitives (Base UI, Radix, React Aria). Includes a CLI (`npx farsiui@latest`) to init projects and add components. Open Source. Open Code. AI-Ready.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://farsiui.ir/docs): Core ideas—code you own, Persian/RTL-first UX, composable APIs, and AI-ready structure.
- [Components](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components): Browse all available FarsiUI components.
- [CLI](https://farsiui.ir/docs/cli): Command-line tool for initializing projects and installing components (`npx farsiui@latest`).
- [components.json](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components-json): Configuration for style, aliases, Tailwind, and CLI behavior.
- [Package Imports](https://farsiui.ir/docs/package-imports): Use `package.json#imports` (`#...` aliases) instead of `tsconfig` paths.
- [Theming](https://farsiui.ir/docs/theming): Colors, CSS variables, and design tokens.
- [Typeset](https://farsiui.ir/docs/typeset): Typography styles for rendered markdown and streaming content.
- [Changelog](https://farsiui.ir/docs/changelog): Release notes and project updates.
- [Blocks](https://farsiui.ir/docs/blocks): Building blocks and contribution notes.
- [Figma](https://farsiui.ir/docs/figma): Community Figma kits for designing with FarsiUI components.

## Installation

- [Installation](https://farsiui.ir/docs/installation): Choose a framework and set up FarsiUI.
- [Next.js](https://farsiui.ir/docs/installation/next): Install FarsiUI in a Next.js project.
- [Vite](https://farsiui.ir/docs/installation/vite): Install FarsiUI in a Vite project.
- [Manual Installation](https://farsiui.ir/docs/installation/manual): Install FarsiUI without the CLI.

## Components

### Form & Input

- [Field](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/field): Form field with label and error messaging.
- [Button](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/button): Button with multiple variants.
- [Button Group](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/button-group): Group related buttons.
- [Input](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/input): Text input.
- [Input Group](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/input-group): Input with prefix/suffix addons.
- [Input OTP](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/input-otp): One-time password input.
- [Textarea](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/textarea): Multi-line text input.
- [Checkbox](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/checkbox): Checkbox input.
- [Radio Group](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/radio-group): Radio button group.
- [Select](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/select): Select dropdown.
- [Native Select](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/native-select): Styled native HTML select.
- [Switch](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/switch): Toggle switch.
- [Slider](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/slider): Range slider.
- [Calendar](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/calendar): Persian (Jalali) calendar date selection with RTL and fa-IR formatting.
- [Date Picker](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/date-picker): Date picker combining input and calendar.
- [Combobox](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/combobox): Searchable select with autocomplete.
- [Label](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/label): Form label.
- [Questionnaire](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/questionnaire): Multi-step questionnaire with single, multiple, freeform, and skipped answers.

### Layout & Navigation

- [Accordion](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/accordion): Collapsible accordion sections.
- [Breadcrumb](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/breadcrumb): Breadcrumb navigation.
- [Navigation Menu](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/navigation-menu): Accessible nav menu with dropdowns.
- [Sidebar](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/sidebar): Collapsible app sidebar.
- [Tabs](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/tabs): Tabbed interface.
- [Separator](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/separator): Visual content divider.
- [Scroll Area](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/scroll-area): Custom scrollable area.
- [Resizable](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/resizable): Resizable panel layouts.

### Overlays & Dialogs

- [Dialog](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/dialog): Modal dialog.
- [Alert Dialog](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/alert-dialog): Confirmation alert dialog.
- [Sheet](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/sheet): Slide-out panel.
- [Drawer](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/drawer): Mobile-friendly drawer.
- [Popover](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/popover): Floating popover.
- [Tooltip](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/tooltip): Contextual tooltip.
- [Hover Card](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/hover-card): Card shown on hover.
- [Context Menu](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/context-menu): Right-click context menu.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/dropdown-menu): Dropdown menu.
- [Menubar](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/menubar): Horizontal menubar.
- [Command](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/command): Command palette.

### Feedback & Status

- [Alert](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/alert): Inline alert messages.
- [Toast](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/toast): Temporary toast notifications.
- [Progress](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/progress): Progress bar.
- [Spinner](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/spinner): Loading spinner.
- [Skeleton](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/skeleton): Loading placeholder.
- [Badge](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/badge): Status and label badge.
- [Empty](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/empty): Empty state UI.

### Display & Media

- [Avatar](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/avatar): User avatar.
- [Card](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/card): Content card container.
- [Table](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/table): Data table markup.
- [Data Table](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/data-table): Advanced table with sorting/filtering.
- [Chart](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/chart): Charts powered by Recharts.
- [Carousel](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/carousel): Carousel (Embla).
- [Aspect Ratio](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/aspect-ratio): Aspect-ratio container.
- [Typography](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/typography): Typography styles.
- [Item](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/item): List/menu item primitive.
- [Kbd](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/kbd): Keyboard shortcut display.
- [Marker](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/marker): Inline marker/highlight for text.
- [Bubble](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/bubble): Chat-style message bubble.
- [Message](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/message): Chat message layout with avatar and content.
- [Message Scroller](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/message-scroller): Auto-scrolling message list for chats.
- [Attachment](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/attachment): File/link attachment UI.

### Misc

- [Collapsible](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/collapsible): Expand/collapse container.
- [Toggle](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/toggle): Toggle button.
- [Toggle Group](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/toggle-group): Group of toggles.
- [Pagination](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/pagination): Pagination controls.
- [Direction](https://farsiui.ir/docs/components/direction): Text direction provider for RTL/LTR.

## Packages

- [Questionnaire (@farsiui/react)](https://farsiui.ir/docs/react/questionnaire): Accessible multi-step questionnaires from `@farsiui/react`.
- [Message Scroller (@farsiui/react)](https://farsiui.ir/docs/react/message-scroller): Message list scrolling helpers from `@farsiui/react`.
- [AI SDK (@farsiui/helpers)](https://farsiui.ir/docs/helpers/ai-sdk): Stream predefined AI conversations without a live model/API.
- [TanStack AI (@farsiui/helpers)](https://farsiui.ir/docs/helpers/tanstack-ai): Helpers for TanStack AI integrations.

## Utilities

- [scroll-fade](https://farsiui.ir/docs/utils/scroll-fade): Edge fade effect for scroll containers.
- [shimmer](https://farsiui.ir/docs/utils/shimmer): Shimmer loading utility styles.

## Advanced

- [Monorepo](https://farsiui.ir/docs/monorepo): Use FarsiUI and the CLI in monorepo workspaces (`init --monorepo`).
- [JavaScript](https://farsiui.ir/docs/javascript): Use JavaScript components (`tsx: false` in `components.json`).
- [Package Imports](https://farsiui.ir/docs/package-imports): Private `#...` import aliases via `package.json#imports`.

## CLI quick start

```bash
npx farsiui@latest init
npx farsiui@latest add button
```

Monorepo:

```bash
npx farsiui@latest init --monorepo
cd apps/web
npx farsiui@latest add button
```
